messages:
kevin_release: Kicking off a config-only deploy now — adjusting routing weight + tiny-batch settings. Canary 5% for 30m. No model/version change.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued. Change ID: cfg-20260321-17

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic -> routing.policy.weight=0.7, batching.tiny_batch_size=6, timeouts.request_ms=18000

tara_sre: noted. I'll watch p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate and queue depth. Setting a short-lived alert.

maria_ops: heads-up infra: tiny_batch_size bump — any risk of memory spikes on the inference pool?

sam_platform: infra looked OK in dry-run; tinybatch has backpressure controls. We bumped min-replicas by 1 in the canary pool proactively.

olivia_pm: Adding to release notes draft: "Config-only: routing weight adjusted; smaller tiny batch to improve tail latency". Any user-facing risk?

kevin_release: No model change; user output identical. Risk: transient latency for long-context flows while caches warm. Rollback plan = revert config + unpin canary.

tara_sre: Rollback checklist (quick):
1) POST /api/internal/releases/cfg-rollback cfg-20260321-17
2) revert routing.policy.weight to 0.85
3) batching.tiny_batch_size -> 4
4) scale down canary pool to 0
5) notify #customer-impact if >10m degradation

maria_ops: copying minimal config snippet for ops:

```
routing:
  policy:
    weight: 0.7
batching:
  tiny_batch_size: 6
timeouts:
  request_ms: 18000
```

sam_platform: +1 to snippet. Automation: if p95 > 600ms OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m, deploy-bot will auto-unpin.

deploy-bot: Metrics stream created -> https://obs.redwood/streams/cfg-20260321-17

olivia_pm: Proposal: keep at 5% until either 30m elapsed AND 10k reqs seen. Prefer stable sample before 50% roll.

kevin_release: Agreed. Canary conditions: 30m OR 10k requests (whichever is later). Checkpoint at +30m.

tara_sre: I'll be online for the window. If anything odd I will trigger rollback. :eyes:

maria_ops: Applied canary config; deploy-bot reports success.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: 5% active. No immediate errors reported.

kevin_release: Thanks — please add a short final line to release notes when we promote.

olivia_pm: Drafting final note now. Holding for metrics.

(30m update)

tara_sre: Observed small p99 bump on long-context tenants, p95 unchanged, 5xx stable at 0.12%. Not promoting yet.

sam_platform: Agree — extend canary another 30m. We'll keep the automation thresholds in place.

kevin_release: Extending to 60m total. If stable, promote to 25% and finalize release notes.

olivia_pm: Noted and will update note accordingly.

maria_ops: FYI we saw slight KV cache pressure during peak; infra to investigate before wider rollout to avoid tail regressions.

kevin_release: Good catch. We'll hold promotion until infra has a quick look and confirms no action needed.

(ongoing monitoring)

kevin_release: Thread will be our coordination point; rollback if thresholds breached. Will post promote steps if we greenlight.
